title: Drug development models for ultra-rare disorders
title_zh: 极罕见疾病的药物开发模式
abstract: The traditional for-profit model of drug development is not sustainable for rare and ultra-rare neurological conditions, so alternative models are needed. Here, we consider some of the programmes and initiatives that are providing viable pathways.
abstract_zh: 传统的营利性药物开发模式对于罕见和极罕见神经系统疾病不可持续，因此需要替代模式。本文考虑了一些提供可行途径的方案和举措。
snippet: The traditional for-profit model of drug development is not sustainable for rare and ultra-rare neurological conditions, so alternative models are needed. Here, we consider some of the programmes and initiatives that are providing viable pathways.
